view_title: รูปขยายคานต่อเนื่อง B4A,B4 (4.00+4.00) และ B5A,B5 (4.00+4.00) พร้อมรูปตัด 4-4, 4A-4A, 5-5, 5A-5A
warnings: Ø-symbol callouts recorded as type RB per §0.6; ø16 bars conflict with notes S-01 ข้อ 2.2 (SD-40 for ≥12 mm) — same standing convention as the other S sheets.

B4A+B4 and B5A+B5 are each drawn as one two-span continuous elevation (4.00+4.00 over the centre support at grid B). The mid-span sections give each mark's own top/bottom counts; the elevation adds support-zone bars: extra top bars over the centre support extending 1.00 into each span, and bottom-bar curtail points 0.50 from supports. Those support-zone extras are recorded in the notes of each mark rather than inflating the mid-span counts.

B5's stirrup callout changes along the span: '2ป ø6มม@0.15' (paired stirrups) over the zone adjacent to the centre support, 'ป ø6มม@0.15' elsewhere — recorded as spacing 150 with variable_spacing note per §0.5's variable-stirrup rule (smallest effective spacing kept).
